rounds.recommend: park (the decision's stop rule: no invariant handle found)
rounds.mechanism: Records are (side, pair-frame token list); oracle.c runs the TM exactly between records. Six record-level rules: L (left-end carry transducer, domain now stated), R6 (end rule), RE (right-end eat bounce = one right-to-left parity transducer P0/P1 with +2/+1 start, P0: even 0 / odd -1, P1: even +2 / odd +3, stopping in P0 at a 000 marker or an extra 1, balance absorbed so the total is +1 pair; E is its all-even case), F and FM (full returns RA>LA, plain and through a double marker), LR (left-end run-off, two endings). RA records live in a tiny language (all extras 0 except 268 records with one 1; 0-3 markers); the counter lives on the LA side.
closed_gaps: Random validation against the TM (oracle.c, canonical configs): R6, RE, F, FM, LR, L each 2,000/2,000 (validate.py seeds 6, 7; validation_final.txt)

Abstract simulator (absim.py) reproduces every A-record of all four orbits (starts A/B/D/E = holdouts 156/450/188/564) to 1e10 with 0 mismatches; start A: 98,334 moves = RE 67,063 + L 30,720 + F 153 + LR 150 + R6 133 + FM 52 + 63 unruled
Unruled moves 668 -> 63 per orbit (0.064%): 57 LA>RA run-offs with other endings or zero-segment merges, 3 LA>LA merges, 2 triple-marker returns, 1 double-marker RA>RA
Of the 5 families named in the decision: the 6-step end rule (R6) and the first eat bounces (RE, odd segments) are ruled; full returns 205/207 (F + FM); run-offs 150/207 (LR); merges still open

L transducer domain corrected: in all four orbits every chain that reaches the end entry runs off to the right, so the end entries are unused, and zero segments break L (it fired wrongly once, at start D record 103, before the domain fix)
remaining_gaps: No invariant handle: no closed record language containing the orbit and excluding the halting window 1 1 0 <C; random RA configs outside the record language halt (104/4,000)
Macro hierarchy not probed beyond observe (the LA-side counter, driven by parities of large segments)
63 unruled moves per orbit in about 6 fixed shapes
